A white or yellowish-white, crystal- line powder or crystals. It exhibits polymorphism. Very slightly soluble in water and in dehydrated alcohol; freely soluble in gla- cial acetic acid; practically insoluble in ethyl acetate. It dissolves in dilute mineral acids. Protect from light.
